description.content: Record when a user activates a batch-activation placement slot. Writes a slot-level `placementSlotAttribution` ACTIVATE event and fans out a per-offer `offerAttribution` ACTIVATE event for every offer resolved by the slot's content strategy. The slot-level event id and the resolved `offerIds` are returned so the partner can render the batch immediately without an extra round-trip to re-fetch the placement content. Required scopes: `attributions:write`
